notes.title: Zoom + general update
notes.notes:
There's been plenty of work and updates on Master of Chess game, but I finally got a moment to update CORB.

Added Zoom!

Let me know if you encounter issues or need more features.

notes.title: Master of Chess is released to Early Access!
notes.notes:
The big poppa of this game is released to Steam Early Access!

This little tool was created as an extracted feature from my dream game, a chess career simulator - Master of Chess. It's finally out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2248900/Master_of_Chess

Give it a try and let me know what you think!

notes.title: Added Import PGN!
notes.notes:
I thought it would be a simple thing but it turned out that having Import PGN functionality required some extra work. I think I managed to pull it off. 

Let me know how it works!

notes.title: Small bug fixes
notes.notes:
- Switched the AI ELO selection to be a dropdown
- Fixed the weird bug where new players would have the board oriented as black and completely misaligned
- Fixed the initial selection of showing AI lines to true

notes.title: First QOL improvements and bugfixes
notes.notes:
First week of CORB's life on Steam has passed. I've got numerous suggestions on how this tool can be improved and I've added few changes:

[list]
[*] Added board orientation switching on openings graph screen
[*] Saving the game settings for your second playthrough
[*] Added searching for openings by playing the moves on the board
[*] Fixed bug with AI not being restarted fast enough when ELO is changed on match screen
[*] Added "turn off AI suggestions" feature for correspondence players
[*] Added resizing of opening move info panel
[/list]
